clue.text: One in dire straits could be Horace

definitions.note: the Roman poet Horace wrote the Satires, so he is an example

indicators.note: the word One is placed within the jumbled letters
dire straits are a sorry mess, so the letters of straits are put in disorder

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone in serious trouble might turn out to be the poet Horace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dire' rearranges STRAITS and 'in' puts I (one) inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Horace was a Roman writer of verse satires, mocking folly.

clue.text: Guy in spin

definitions.meaning: a guy is a man, and ... is a man's name
a spin is a whirling motion, as of water swirling round

explanation.surface: A man caught up in a whirl.
explanation.definitionFit: Double meaning: a man's name, so a fellow or bloke, and a circular current of water or air.

clue.text: Two lots of Mary Jane's brewing equipment

indicators.note: two different slang names for the same drug are wanted, one after the other

parts.note: Mary Jane is slang for cannabis, also called tea
cannabis is also called pot

explanation.surface: A double helping of someone's homemade cannabis paraphernalia.
explanation.walkthrough: Mary Jane, tea and pot are all old slang terms for marijuana.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel for steeping leaves in boiling water is literally equipment used for brewing.

clue.text: Harry Potter taking drug a high point for Rowan

indicators.note: the scrambled word takes in the drug letter, holding it inside
to harry is to harass or worry, so the letters of Potter are disturbed

parts.note: E is the usual abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Harry Potter on drugs is a high point for his friend Ron... or rather Rowan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Harry' rearranges POTTER to TRETOP, and 'taking' puts E (ecstasy) inside. Rowan is not a person but the mountain ash.
explanation.definitionFit: Rowan is a tree, so its loftiest part, the crown of its branches, is its high point.

clue.text: Hit works about Jacob's relative with right vocabulary in these

indicators.note: the reworked letters go around the next pieces
works as a verb means kneads or reshapes, so the letters of Hit are rearranged

parts.note: Esau was Jacob's twin brother in Genesis

explanation.surface: A hit play's works deal with a Bible figure, rich in correct words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'works' is a verb meaning reshapes, not plays or books; 'about' puts the result round the brother and right. The definition leans on the rest of the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Books of synonyms are collections of words, so a store of vocabulary sits in such volumes.

clue.text: The main youth supporting Frank in free time

indicators.note: in a down entry a supporting piece sits beneath, so the other parts come first

parts.note: frank means candid or open
the main is an old poetic term for the sea
a son is a youth, a young man

explanation.surface: A seafaring lad backs a candid friend in his leisure hours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporting' in a down clue puts SEA and SON below OPEN.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the period when hunting is permitted, so a time when game is free to be taken.

clue.text: Terry's very good fortune? Not half

definitions.note: read as 'Terry is', naming terry, a looped cotton cloth

parts.note: fab is slang for fabulous, very good

indicators.note: only half of the word survives, the back half dropped

parts.note: a fortune is great riches

explanation.surface: Someone called Terry has had a great stroke of luck... well, not half.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not half' cuts RICHES to RIC. Terry is not a man here but towelling cloth, and the 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Terry towelling is a woven cloth, a kind of textile material.

clue.text: Sibyl follows bag painter

indicators.note: the prophetess comes after the word for bag

parts.note: to bag something is to land or secure it
a sibyl is a prophetess, a seer

explanation.surface: A woman called Sibyl is trailing after a handbag-carrying artist.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Edwin Landseer was the Victorian painter of animals who designed the lions in Trafalgar Square.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Edwin Landseer was a celebrated English artist known for animal pictures.

clue.text: Cool sort of record Henry and Tom cover

indicators.note: the outer letters wrap around the record

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
a tom is a male cat
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: Henry and Tom do a cover of some cool record.
explanation.definitionFit: Old jazz slang for a stylish, fashionable person in the know.

clue.text: Ruth's mine and yours, at first

definitions.note: read as 'ruth is', ruth being an old word for compassion

parts.note: a pit is a coal mine

indicators.note: only the opening letter of yours is used

explanation.surface: Ruth says the property is now jointly hers and yours.
explanation.walkthrough: Ruth is no woman here: it is an archaic noun meaning compassion (as in ruthless).
explanation.definitionFit: Ruth is an old word for compassion, sorrow felt for others' suffering.

clue.text: Sally's in class, penning Latin

definitions.note: read as 'sally is', a sally being a witty remark

indicators.note: the class holds the letter inside, as in a pen

parts.note: the peasantry is a social class

explanation.surface: Sally is in a lesson, writing Latin.
explanation.walkthrough: Sally is not a girl here but a quip; the 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a witty remark or joke, the same as a polite or humorous remark.

clue.text: Clingy type left Mike, taken by current favourite

indicators.note: the current and favourite letters hold the Mike letter between them

parts.note: I is the physics symbol for electric current
a pet is a favourite
Mike is M in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A needy person dumped Mike, who was snapped up by the latest darling.
explanation.definitionFit: This shellfish clamps tightly to rocks, so it figures as anyone who will not let go.

clue.text: Bull where Jack's found round rushes

parts.note: a jack is a playing card, found in a pack
O is round in shape
to fly is to rush along

explanation.surface: A bull in a place where Jack is, with flies buzzing around.
explanation.definitionFit: Bull is slang for nonsense or untruths, a whole set of falsehoods.

clue.text: Oscar regularly pulls in money for luxury

parts.note: Oscar is O in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: the picked letters are placed inside the money

parts.note: pence are money

indicators.note: every other letter of pulls is taken

explanation.surface: Oscar routinely rakes in cash to live the high life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes UL from pulls, put 'in' PENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Great wealth and lavishness, a synonym for living in luxury.

clue.text: For Dirk, pedant's out of line

indicators.note: the line letter is removed from the word

parts.note: a stickler is a pedant; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: For a man named Dirk, a fussy person is behaving improperly.
explanation.walkthrough: Dirk is not a name here but a dagger; the 's on pedant's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirk is a dagger, and slang names a knife a sticker, a thing that stabs.

clue.text: He should be in Nick's wild revel, one engaging cook

definitions.note: Old Nick is the devil, so Nick's is hell, where a sinner belongs

indicators.note: wild suggests disorder, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: one is the numeral I, which takes on (engages) a cook: to do food is to cook it, giving I with DO

explanation.surface: A man ought to be at Nick's riotous party, one involving a cook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' shuffles REVEL together with I and DO, the one and the cook it engages. Old Nick is a nickname for the devil, so Nick's place is hell.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrongdoer, sinner by trade, is the sort expected to end up in the devil's domain.

clue.text: What Victor will do, a bit charming

parts.note: a victor wins
some means a bit, a certain amount

explanation.surface: Victor will no doubt be a little charming.
explanation.walkthrough: Victor is not a man's name but anyone who triumphs.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: appealing and engaging in an innocent way.

clue.text: Mary drops a name introducing artist and player

indicators.note: the artist is brought into the middle of the shortened word
the name letter is let fall from the word

parts.note: the Madonna is Mary, mother of Jesus
N is the abbreviation for name
an RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: Mary leaves out a name when introducing an artist and an actor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drops' removes one of the two Ns and 'introducing' puts the Royal Academician inside. 'Mary' here is the Virgin, not a pop star.
explanation.definitionFit: Diego Maradona was an Argentinian footballer, so an example of a sports player.

clue.text: Tommy's revealing little

definitions.meaning: read as 'Tommy is'; a Tommy is a British soldier, the lowest rank being one
keeping things secret, giving little away

explanation.surface: A boy named Tommy is showing off very little.
explanation.walkthrough: Tommy (from Tommy Atkins) is old slang for a British private soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Double meaning: a soldier of lowest rank, and secretive or confidential.

clue.text: Track plugged by Kelvin that is more unsettling

indicators.note: the track is filled with the next letters, which go inside it

parts.note: a spoor is the track of a wild animal
K is the symbol for the kelvin, the unit of temperature
i.e. is short for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A path blocked by someone called Kelvin is rather disturbing.
explanation.definitionFit: Comparative of eerie or ghostly, so creepier and more disquieting.

clue.text: Guy in spin? That's correct

indicators.note: the guy goes inside the spin letters

parts.note: PR, public relations, is spin
a guy is a rope used to steady a tent

explanation.surface: Is a man caught in a whirl the right way to describe him?
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: right, fitting or conforming to standards.

clue.text: Norman's bird providing fake news

definitions.meaning: the French word for duck, as a Frenchman from Normandy would say
a false report or baseless rumour

explanation.surface: Norman's pet duck is the source of untrue stories.
explanation.definitionFit: Double meaning: French for duck, and an unfounded rumour or false story.

clue.text: Morgan, say, and Paddy dress down

parts.note: Morgan is a British make of sports car
a paddy is a fit of temper, as is a pet

explanation.surface: Morgan and Paddy put on casual clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: Morgan and Paddy look like two people but are a sports car brand and a tantrum.
explanation.definitionFit: To be carpeted is to be called in for a reprimand, so to scold or tell off.

clue.text: Amazed to play Viola, line's forgotten in Cliff's place

parts.note: a viola is played with a bow

indicators.note: the word in is dropped from line, as if forgotten

parts.note: the word line itself, the 's meaning has
Dover is famous for its white cliffs

explanation.surface: An actor playing Viola is stunned to forget a line on stage in Dover.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'line's forgotten in' as LINE has lost IN, leaving LE. Viola is the heroine of Twelfth Night but also a stringed instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: knocked flat with surprise, as a stunned person is.

clue.text: Grant's a court favourite, according to hearsay

definitions.note: read as 'grant is'; to grant is to give up or concede

indicators.note: the word is heard spoken, so a soundalike is written

parts.note: a seed is a top-ranked tennis player

explanation.surface: Grant is apparently a favourite on the tennis court.
explanation.walkthrough: Grant is not a man here but a verb; the 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: To grant land or rights is to yield or hand them over.

clue.text: Chuck Norris finally punching Leo, for one

indicators.note: the letter punches into the middle of the cat

parts.note: Leo, the lion, is a big cat

indicators.note: the last letter of Norris is taken

explanation.surface: Chuck Norris, the martial arts star, ends up punching a man named Leo.
explanation.walkthrough: Chuck Norris is the action film star; here Chuck is the verb, to throw.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to throw or toss something, as a fisherman throws a line.

clue.text: One travelling late, a shade before Amber picked up yours truly

parts.note: on UK traffic lights red comes before amber

indicators.note: picked up means heard, so a soundalike is written

parts.note: yours truly means me, I

explanation.surface: A late traveller sees a colour before Amber collects the speaker.
explanation.walkthrough: On British traffic lights red shows alone, then red with amber, before green.
explanation.definitionFit: An overnight flight is called this, so a passenger on it is a late traveller.

clue.text: Nancy's really with Carol, making a coiffure

parts.note: Nancy is a French city, and tres is French for very or really
to carol is to sing

explanation.surface: Nancy is truly with Carol doing hair.
explanation.walkthrough: Nancy is not a woman but the city in eastern France.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranging hair into tresses or locks is styling a hairdo.
